Definition: properly, something meeting, i.e. a frame (of timbers)
BiblicalUsage: Meqareh is the frame of timbers, the meeting of the beams in a house. Ecclesiastes 10:18 blames slothfulness when the building decayeth and the house droppeth through.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a house falls slowly before it falls suddenly, and the frame rots while the owner idles.
